title: El poder militar
goal: Read a closing comparison of Brazil, Chile, and Argentina's military governments, the Operation Condor repression coordinated across the Southern Cone, and why no regime lasted indefinitely.

items: List the traits Brazil, Chile, and Argentina's regimes shared.
